review_description: Carbo Solar provided an excellent service and installation. The provider explained the whole process in detail and was punctual.

As a return customer, with 60 panels and 3 batteries, the site visits and quoting process is always prompt and market priced and value for money.  We have recommended Carbo Solar to many family members, friends, work colleagues who have ordered and had soar systems installed.The installations are always undertaken on the mutual scheduled timeline.  The installers are always punctual and tidy whilst installing the batteries, inverters and solar panels.The customer service is exceptional throughout the whole installation process and assisting with organising the grid connection with the service provider.
The sales & quoting process was excellent.The installation of inverter & panels was extremely neat & tidy.All paper work & approvals were handled by the installer.
No problems, Pleased with the result so far. Haven't had a power bill yet.
